## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky39

Rebased the BuildBuddy JVM release onto upstream `release-9.3.0` at [`33cd173785e3`](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/33cd173785e303748e059377169eaabc603781ff), preserving the existing downstream changes. This includes upstream fixes for remote downloader cleanup, remote executor thread-pool reuse, Windows parameter-file escaping, C++ include scanning, and repository-cache materialization. Upstream also restores the disabled default for `--rewind_lost_inputs` and removes the default `java.net.preferIPv6Addresses=system` JVM argument.

- Construct canonical labels without intermediate package-identifier strings ([#79](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/79), upstream [#31365](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31365)).
- Memoize immutable execution-info modifier strings used by configuration checksums ([#80](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/80), upstream [#31366](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31366)).
- Collect configuration keys by input index instead of a temporary hash map, preserving input order and key/value associations ([#81](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/81), upstream [#31367](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31367)).
- Share the immutable C++ option filter that accepts every option ([#82](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/82), upstream 9.3 [#31368](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31368)).
- Omit the unused flattened-list cache field from flat `NestedSet` instances, backporting jhorvitz's upstream change ([#83](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/83)).
- Store the first two direct elements and transitive sets in `NestedSetBuilder` without hash sets. Preserve the upstream singleton guard when considering a deserialization future for reuse, backporting twerth's changes ([#84](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/84)).

### Validation

[Combined release validation](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/actions/runs/36331904200) passed with uncached tests on non-root Linux. The tests cover label formatting, execution-info modifiers, configuration producers, C++ option filters, NestedSet ordering/builders/serialization, Bzlmod, remote-cache behavior, and FastCDC/RepMaxCDC integration. The rebase preserves the downstream chunk-size rejection tests and repository-recovery tests.

### Prebuilts

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before immutable publication, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance records.
